hero.h1: Faucet Repair and Installation in Mokena, IL
hero.sub: A dripping kitchen faucet, a bathroom faucet that won't shut off or an outdoor spigot that split last winter. We repair and install faucets and fixtures in Mokena homes. From our office on Jodi Road.

tiles.h3: It Drips After You Shut It Off

tiles.body: A leaking supply line or connection.
A clogged aerator or a failing cartridge.
A freeze crack behind the wall.

bodies: Kitchen faucets work harder than any other fixture in the house. We replace cartridges, fix leaking pull-down hoses and install new faucets, including models with sprayers and soap dispensers.
Builder-grade faucets from the 1990s and 2000s are a common replacement in Mokena. If you're replacing the sink too, we can handle the plumbing for both.
Beyond the faucet, we handle the rest of the kitchen: drains, shutoff valves, dishwasher connections, ice maker lines and [garbage disposals](/mokena/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).
Remodeling the kitchen? We can move or add plumbing for an island sink, a pot filler or a second dishwasher.

img.alt: Plumbing under a double kitchen sink: white PVC drain and P-trap, braided supply lines with chrome shutoff valves, and a garbage disposal

bodies: We install sinks, faucets, toilets, showerheads and other fixtures throughout the house, and we make sure the shutoffs and supply lines are in good shape while we're there.
Replacing several fixtures at once? We can plan the work so it's done in one visit.

blocks.h2: Faucets and Fixtures in Mokena Homes
blocks.intro: Many Mokena homes still have the faucets and shutoffs they were built with.

items.body: Original faucets from the 1990s and 2000s are often worn and hard to find parts for.
Old valves under sinks can seize. We replace them when we replace the faucet.
A spigot that froze can crack inside the wall and leak when you turn it on in spring. A frost-proof spigot prevents it.

items.q: Should I repair or replace my faucet?
items.preview: It depends on the faucet's age and parts.
items.answer: If the faucet is in good shape and parts are available, a repair is fine. Older builder-grade faucets are often worth replacing.

items.q: Can you install a faucet I bought?
items.answer: Yes. We'll install a faucet you bought, as long as it's a quality model with the right parts.

items.q: Why does my outdoor spigot leak inside the house?
items.answer: Usually the pipe behind the spigot froze and cracked. We replace it, often with a frost-proof spigot.
Yes. We replace old or seized shutoff valves, usually when we're already working on the fixture.

items.preview: It depends on the faucet. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the faucet and what's wrong. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
